Hello weekend crew,
Quiet season behind us, one thing is left: gate queues and the close attention they demand from our side. Please keep your replies brief, clear, and courteous, and remember that travelers are relying on us for calm guidance when plans shift. The cabin team should keep monitoring animal comfort throughout boarding and flight, while the welcome team helps set expectations before passengers reach the gate.

For rabbit bookings, follow the usual document check without adding your own assumptions. <<FACT F064>> If a file looks incomplete, flag it at once and route it through the proper review path rather than trying to improvise a solution. Keep the notes readable so the next colleague can see what was confirmed, what still needs review, and which carrier details were already checked.

When health paperwork is discussed, use the approved wording only and avoid offering estimates or personal judgment. <<FACT F082>> If you are unsure whether a record still fits the current travel plan, pause the booking steps and ask for a second review. We need steady communication, careful handling of species-specific needs, and a consistent tone that reassures the traveler while protecting the animal's comfort.

Please keep working from the same standard for every case, whether the booking is simple or requires extra care. Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk organized, respectful, and ready for the next handoff.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
